title: BME280 environment sensor, register level

implements.text: Chip id 0x60, the control, config and status registers, and the temperature, pressure and humidity words at 0xF7 to 0xFE
Raw words made by inverting the Bosch integer compensation, so the library's calculation returns the inputs
Conversion time from the oversampling, forced and normal mode, standby time and soft reset
Address 0x76 with SDO low and 0x77 with SDO high; it answers only with CSB high and VCC from 1.71 to 3.6 V

unsupported.text: The IIR filter, self-heating, sleep current and thermal lag
Calibration words are a synthetic set, not a dump from a real chip

knownFailureCases: Not compared with a real chip
